settings.field.closeToTray.label.translation: Keep running when the window closes

settings.field.closeToTray.help.translation: Closing the window hides it to the tray (the Dock on macOS) so Claude sessions and terminals keep running. Quit from the tray menu. Without a tray, closing always quits.

settings.field.language.help.translation: Language for the app interface; applies live.

settings.field.logLevel.help.translation: How much clide writes to its log and the Output dock. Same as `clide log level`.
